name: count_words
description: Conveyor from EX0/output. Per workpiece: count the words in document.txt and write result.json. An empty document fails and lands in EX1/failed.

steps.name: Transfer workpieces from EX0
steps.description: Move workpieces from EX0/output/ into EX1/input/.

steps.name: Count words
